sourceBoundary: The existing formal workflow checked out the exact head and ran its original daemon build/npm-pack commands, with no temporary product or fixture overlay. The Mac jobs download this same-run artifact by fixed name.
limitations: Npm package-size display is rounded and is not asserted as an exact byte count.
The npm sha512 integrity display was truncated, so it is not used as a full integrity value.
The artifact ZIP and actual tarball were not downloaded independently; ZIP SHA256 is the upload action's logged digest, and package SHA1 is npm's logged shasum.
